import ctypes
import os
import math

# Load the libraries
libgslcblas = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the gsl_sf_result structure
class gsl_sf_result(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('val', ctypes.c_double), ('err', ctypes.c_double)]

# Define the function prototype
# int gsl_sf_lambert_W0_e(double x, gsl_sf_result * result)
gsl.gsl_sf_lambert_W0_e.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.POINTER(gsl_sf_result)]
gsl.gsl_sf_lambert_W0_e.restype = ctypes.c_int

# Define the Python function
def lambert_w0(x):
    result = gsl_sf_result()
    status = gsl.gsl_sf_lambert_W0_e(ctypes.c_double(x), ctypes.byref(result))
    if status != 0:
        raise ValueError('Error in computing Lambert W function')
    return result.val

# Test cases

    # Test with known values
    assert math.isclose(lambert_w0(0.0), 0.0, rel_tol=1e-9), 'Test case 1 failed'

    assert math.isclose(lambert_w0(-1.0/math.e), -1.0, rel_tol=1e-9), 'Test case 3 failed'
